rbn-interims-warning-2026-08-20.main_change: Revenue growth was outweighed by a sharp fall in underlying operating profit, lower gross margin, higher costs and higher net debt; the note should frame the new evidence as weaker earnings quality without inventing a prior company-guidance comparator.
human_reference: Do not let revenue growth obscure the sharp fall in underlying operating profit and gross margin.
Identify cost inflation and operating-cost pressure as the important deterioration where disclosed.
Treat the new full-year profit range as current guidance; do not call it an upgrade or downgrade unless an explicit prior company guidance comparator is in eligible evidence.
Keep balance-sheet/property support separate from the weaker current earnings evidence.
